resources.string: Serve your Hexis tasks and notes to a browser on the same Wi-Fi. Nothing leaves this device until you open the page — each paired device has its own end-to-end-encryption key you can revoke anytime.
Tap “Connect to Hexis” and approve access, then start the server.
Start the server, then add a device to show its QR.
Add a device (full access) or a read-only share link, then scan its QR or open its link on a browser on the same Wi-Fi. The part after “#” is that device’s key — it never leaves your devices.
